critical.issue: Knockout advancement bug: After final match is played, the advance_knockout function continues to generate new matches. When both semi-finals are complete and final is played, it creates duplicate Final matches (e.g., 'Team C vs Team C'). The check_winner function returns the winner but advance_knockout still runs and creates extra matches.
critical.reproduction_steps: 1. Create 4-team knockout tournament, 2. Enter both semi-final results, 3. Enter final result - observe duplicate match generated
critical.suggested_fix: In advance_knockout(), add check: if check_winner(tournament) is not None, skip advancement. Also verify 'Final' round already has played match before generating new matches.

issues: ADD button for teams may have small touch target - coordinate clicks sometimes miss. Consider larger hit area.

rca_of_issue.issue: Knockout advancement creates duplicate matches after final
rca_of_issue.root_cause: In submit_match_result (line 1371-1401), advance_knockout() is called BEFORE check_winner(). The advance_knockout function doesn't verify if tournament is already complete. After final match result is submitted, advance_knockout still runs and sees 'Final' round is complete, then tries to generate 'next round' with the winners - resulting in self-vs-self matches.
rca_of_issue.mitigation: Add early return in advance_knockout() if tournament.status == 'completed' or if check_winner(tournament) returns a value. Also ensure advance_knockout doesn't create matches when only 1 team/winner remains.
